transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve stopped wanting to do the things that usually keep me going. Salsa nights, church gatherings, cooking for the neighbors... even going into my shop just to smell the wood. I just don’t feel like doing any of it.
About how long have you felt this lack of interest in doing things?
About six months, I’d say. It’s been going on long enough that it doesn’t feel like just a rough patch or regular stress anymore.
Did a particular stressful event or major life change happen around the time these feelings started?
Yeah. About two months ago, my wife’s health took a sudden turn, and our whole routine changed. That’s when I noticed this change in my mood and how I’ve been acting.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life, where you lost interest or felt down?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time it felt like this for this long.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually energized, wired, or 'on top of the world'?

Yeah, at the beginning of all this, I had stretches where I felt really fired up—like I could take on anything. But I was also quick to snap. If my wife or somebody on the crew questioned me, I’d get angry over practically nothing.
During those stretches when you felt fired up and easily angered, about how many days in a row did that feeling last?
I couldn’t really say exactly. It felt like it came and went, and I wasn’t keeping track of the days.
Have you been experiencing these ups and downs in your mood for two years or more?
No, not two years. This has all been going on for about two months, since my wife’s health took a sudden turn and our routine changed.
